name: aws
description: Amazon Web Services CLI — manage AWS services from the command line

subcommands.name: s3
subcommands.description: Manage Amazon S3 buckets and objects

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Apply the command to every key under the prefix

options.name: --delete
options.description: Delete destination files missing from the source

subcommands.name: s3api
examples: aws s3api get-object --bucket mybucket --key file.txt output.txt
aws s3api put-object --bucket mybucket --key file.txt --body file.txt

subcommands.name: ec2
examples: aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-xxx --instance-type t3.micro --key-name mykey

options.name: --force-new-deployment
options.description: Start a new deployment even without changes

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: IAM role to assume for the cluster

subcommands.name: lambda
examples: aws lambda create-function --function-name myfunc --runtime nodejs20.x --handler index.handler --role arn:aws:iam::xxx:role/myrole --zip-file fileb://function.zip

subcommands.name: rds
examples: aws rds create-db-instance --db-instance-identifier mydb --db-instance-class db.t3.micro --engine postgres --master-username admin --master-user-password secret

options.name: --on-failure
options.description: What to do on failure (DO_NOTHING, ROLLBACK, DELETE)

subcommands.name: ecr
examples: aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com

subcommands.name: ssm
subcommands.description: Systems Manager parameter store and sessions

options.name: --role-session-name
options.description: Session name for the assumed role

options.name: --external-id
options.description: External id for the trust policy

subcommands.name: configure
subcommands.description: Configure AWS CLI credentials and settings

subcommands.name: apigateway
subcommands.description: REST API management for API Gateway

subcommands.name: apigatewayv2
subcommands.description: HTTP and WebSocket APIs for API Gateway

subcommands.name: autoscaling
subcommands.description: EC2 Auto Scaling groups and policies

options.name: --auto-scaling-group-name
options.description: Auto Scaling group to act on

subcommands.name: backup
examples: aws backup start-backup-job --backup-vault-name Default --resource-arn ARN --iam-role-arn ROLE

subcommands.name: batch
examples: aws batch submit-job --job-name j --job-queue q --job-definition d

subcommands.name: cloudwatch
examples: aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/EC2 --metric-name CPUUtilization --period 300 --statistics Average --start-time 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-01-02T00:00:00Z

subcommands.name: elasticache
examples: aws elasticache create-cache-cluster --cache-cluster-id my-redis --engine redis --cache-node-type cache.t3.micro --num-cache-nodes 1

subcommands.name: kinesis
examples: aws kinesis put-record --stream-name my-stream --partition-key k --data hello
aws kinesis get-shard-iterator --stream-name my-stream --shard-id shardId-000000000000 --shard-iterator-type LATEST

subcommands.name: redshift
examples: aws redshift create-cluster --cluster-identifier my-dw --node-type dc2.large --master-username admin --master-user-password PASS

options.name: --tag-keys
options.description: Tag keys to remove or list

subcommands.name: transcribe
examples: aws transcribe start-transcription-job --transcription-job-name job --media MediaFileUri=s3://bucket/audio.mp3 --language-code en-US

subcommands.name: wafv2

options.name: --name
options.description: Web ACL or rule group name

examples: aws wafv2 get-web-acl --name my-acl --scope REGIONAL --id ID

subcommands.name: amplify
subcommands.description: Hosting and backends for web and mobile apps
examples: aws amplify start-job --app-id APP --branch-name main --job-type RELEASE

options.name: --domain-name
options.description: Domain to request a certificate for

globalOptions.name: --dry-run
globalOptions.description: Check permissions without making the request

detectors.name: caller_identity
detectors.description: Current AWS account and IAM identity

detectors.name: cloudformation_stacks
detectors.command: aws cloudformation list-stacks --stack-status-filter CREATE_COMPLETE UPDATE_COMPLETE --query 'StackSummaries[].StackName' --output text 2>/dev/null
